adjudication.rationale: The diff shows duplicated credential rehydration logic in `packages/core/EventManager.ts`: both `createAllCalendarEvents` and `updateCalendarReferences` attempt to find a credential in `this.calendarCredentials`, then fall back to `prisma.credential.findUnique({ include: { app: { select: { slug: true }}}})` and manually assemble a `credential` object with `appName`, `id`, `type`, `key`, `userId`, `teamId`, `invalid`, and `appId`. A third, similar fallback exists in `packages/features/bookings/lib/handleCancelBooking.ts` (it falls back to `prisma.credential.findUnique` when not found in `bookingToDelete.user.credentials`), and unlike the EventManager blocks it does not include/guard on `app.slug`. This is a concrete maintainability/duplication issue introduced/exposed by the diff rather than a direct functional defect.
